notes.title: RE:CALL Launch Day Stream!
notes.content:
[h3]RE:CALL launches today at 12pm EST, and we're hosting a stream right here on Steam to celebrate![/h3]

Are you interested in the game, and want to get a feel for the gameplay and story? Join us as we take you through the first few chapters of RE:CALL, and get a glimpse of the kind of mind-bending puzzles you'll face. In this world, memories are in flux, and rewriting them has immediate effects on the way events play out in the present. It’s up to you to figure out what sequences of actions lead to the desired outcomes. At least, as long as you can remember things correctly... 

We'll see you at noon!
